scope: Monster/Zombie Boss whole-world fast-path stability and AOI restoration recovery

reportedSymptoms: repeated scans can suddenly become very slow
a later scan can appear stuck and stop scanning
diagnosis: coarse LOD2 failure previously fell back silently to the conservative LOD0 full-world scanner
one observed failed run restored camera tile and svLod=0 but left WorldPointManager AOI geometry at blockSize=1000/blockCount=1, then returned zoom_restore_confirmation_timeout

correction.fastOnly: Monster and Zombie Boss whole-world scans no longer fall back to the slow LOD0 coverage path after coarse failure; the fast-path error is surfaced truthfully.
correction.boundedRecovery: On zoom-restore confirmation timeout, the probe makes one bounded native WorldPointManager.UpdateLWAoi_Normal(true) recovery attempt, then rechecks exact LOD0 geometry/camera state before accepting the result.
correction.failClosed: A second failed restore confirmation still terminates the request; no unlimited retry or fabricated completion is permitted.

privacy: Durable evidence is aggregate-only. No live player identity, UUID, coordinates, session/challenge identifiers or account data are retained.
